caption: The drawing depicts a single freestanding arch-shaped object set against a plain, light beige background. The main structure consists of a pointed Gothic-style arch, predominantly colored black with a gold or yellow bordering along its edges. At the apex of the arch, there is a gold triangular element topped by a brown cross with four equal arms, each slightly flared and ending with a knob. Along the inner curve of the arch, there are five evenly spaced silver or gray decorative elements that protrude outward and resemble stylized leaves or finials. The base of the arch has two vertical supports, each equipped with a curving, gold-colored foot that extends outward both to the left and right of their respective bases, giving the arch stability. The overall composition is centered with minimal background detail. In the bottom right corner, the name "V. Van Voris" is written.
title: Carved Wooden Candleholder
